# Round 3: season simulation calibration (generated by research/round3_season.py)

Simulated from before weeks 1, 5, 9 and 13 of every season, 5,000 runs each, using only ratings known at the time. Brier score: lower is better (0.25 = coin flip). #1 seed scored for 2020-25 only. "80% range" = share of teams whose final wins landed inside the simulation's 10th-90th percentile range (ideal: 80%).

| tau (season-long rating uncertainty, pts) | Period | Brier: playoffs | Brier: division | Brier: #1 seed | Win-total error (MAE) | 80% range hit rate |

| 0 | holdout | 0.1661 | 0.1345 | 0.0464 | 1.68 | 76% |
| 1 | development | 0.1442 | 0.1091 | nan | 1.56 | 79% |
| 1 | holdout | 0.1658 | 0.1343 | 0.0462 | 1.68 | 76% |
